clue.text: Sue newspapermen

definitions.meaning: to sue is to urge a claim or petition hard, to push it
reporters as a body are collectively called by this name

explanation.definitionFit: To push a claim is to sue for it, and journalists collectively are the fourth estate's corps of reporters.

clue.text: Maintain a lock-up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: a lock of hair is a tress

explanation.surface: Someone insists on keeping a jail cell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lock-up' looks like a jail cell; split it, and 'up' is the reversal signal in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain a point is to declare it firmly.

clue.text: People responsible for actors clothing and furniture

definitions.meaning: theatre staff who help performers into costume
a sideboard or chest of drawers for clothes or crockery

explanation.definitionFit: Backstage wardrobe assistants share a name with cupboards holding plates or clothes.

clue.text: Looked round about tea-time, but wasn't offered anything to eat

indicators.note: round means the first word goes about the second, enclosing it

parts.note: looked hard means stared
tea is taken around five o'clock, and five is V in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A guest gazes about at teatime, but no food comes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' just means roughly: tea-time is five, V, which goes inside STARED.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone denied food goes hungry, deprived of nourishment.

clue.text: He's a bad lot-or isn't as bad as he's made out

indicators.note: something made out to be bad has been worked over, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rogue who perhaps isn't as wicked as his reputation suggests.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of OR ISN'T AS are rearranged by 'bad as he's made out'.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire-raiser is a criminal, a villain or bad lot.

clue.text: Drawing back a little way, and shy about it

indicators.note: about means the first word goes round the second

parts.note: to shy is to throw, to fling
an inch is a small distance

explanation.surface: Someone recoils a short distance, timid about the matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shy' looks like an adjective for timid, but it is the verb, to throw: FLING goes 'about' INCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Recoiling or wincing from pain or fear is a pulling away.

clue.text: Check furs, treat splits

indicators.note: splits means the letters are broken apart and rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for a furrier: inspect the furs and treat the tears.
explanation.definitionFit: To check a plan is to thwart or foil it.

clue.text: Make a hole in some material

explanation.definitionFit: Boring into a surface and a strong twilled cotton cloth share a name.

clue.text: The head chef prepares this

definitions.meaning: the top of the skull, the crown
a savoury meat or fish paste cooked by a chef

explanation.definitionFit: The crown of the skull and a spreadable meat paste are spelt alike.

clue.text: He rates fools, getting endlessly irritated

parts.note: fools are asses

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: irritated means sore

explanation.surface: A man calls people idiots, losing his temper more and more.
explanation.definitionFit: A valuer or tax official sets the rates owed on property.

clue.text: Sum for which a doctor's been let in by relation

indicators.note: let in by means the doctor goes inside the relation

parts.note: an aunt is a relation
MO, medical officer, is a doctor; the 's stands for has

explanation.surface: A bill run up when a relative admitted the doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue's 'a' is only a link; 'been let in by' is the container signal, with the relation enclosing the doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum is a total or quantity.

clue.text: This may well cause the viewer great irritation

definitions.text: This may well cause the viewer great irritation

parts.words: This may well cause the viewer great irritation
parts.note: the viewer is the eye, and the thing irritating it is a swelling on the eyelid

explanation.definitionFit: A sore inflamed swelling on the eyelid troubles the eye.

clue.text: Sense there's agreement among rowing men

indicators.note: among means one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a rowing eight is a crew of eight oarsmen
yes expresses agreement

explanation.surface: Consensus among the crew of a racing boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight is one of the five senses.

clue.text: Not a great work of art-though it could be

definitions.text: Not a great work of art-though it could be

parts.words: Not a great work of art-though it could be
parts.note: a tiny painting is not large, though it may still be a masterpiece

explanation.definitionFit: A tiny portrait is small in size, not grand, whatever its quality.

clue.text: Seaside accommodation giving rise to complaint

indicators.note: accommodation suggests letters being rearranged to fit a new space

explanation.surface: A seaside lodging that leaves the guest grumbling.
explanation.definitionFit: An illness is a complaint in the medical sense.

clue.text: ACCESS taken here!

parts.note: reads like a shop sign for a credit card, but means the way in

explanation.walkthrough: Access was a British credit card, so the clue reads like a shop notice.
explanation.definitionFit: A way in is where admission is gained.

clue.text: Happy inside

explanation.definitionFit: Satisfied is one sense; the stress shifts for what is held within a container.

clue.text: A doubter can be quite hard to influence

indicators.note: can be means the letters may be turned into something else

explanation.definitionFit: A stubborn person is unmoved by persuasion.

clue.text: Orderly academicians with gun in hold up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the pieces are read backwards from the bottom

parts.note: RA stands for Royal Academician
a Luger is a German pistol

explanation.surface: A tidy group of artists holding a gun in a robbery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hold up' turns RA plus LUGER into the reverse run.
explanation.definitionFit: Something even and methodical follows a pattern.

clue.text: Go back to help big family getting abuse

indicators.note: go back means the word is read backwards

parts.note: help means aid
a tribe is a large family group

explanation.surface: Returning to assist a large clan that is hurling insults.
explanation.definitionFit: A bitter tirade is verbal abuse.

clue.text: An island shows some coastal erosion always

indicators.note: some means only part of the letters is taken

explanation.surface: An island suffers constant erosion of its coast.
explanation.definitionFit: A small Hebridean isle off western Scotland.

clue.text: Discourage rapid movement

definitions.meaning: to ... hopes is to crush them

explanation.definitionFit: Shattering someone's hopes and a quick sprint share a name.
